categories.name: p2p
categories.evidence: Modifies src/i2p.cpp, which handles the I2P transport integration.
categories.rationale: Updates I2P leaseset encryption types to support post-quantum hybrid encryption (MLKEM-768) and drop legacy ElGamal per upstream recommendations. The improvement provides clear compatibility and cryptographic value for I2P users, but is reasonably deferrable without urgency.
